module: Camera filter (isFilter = true, hidden = true): adds a realistic camera sway (head oscillating while walking, breathing when standing) by modifying the position (slight rise) and orientation (pitch, roll, yaw) of the camera result. Not selectable: it is instantiated by other modes (cameraModes/external.lua, cameraModes/steadycam.lua) or by code such as gameplay/rallyStartClock.lua (require('core/cameraModes/bobbing')()). Disabled while an OpenXR session is running. The intensity comes from the cameraSteadycamWalkBob and cameraSteadycamStandingBob settings (0 to 2). The module returns a constructor: require('core/cameraModes/bobbing')(options).
usage:
local bobbing = require('core/cameraModes/bobbing')()
-- every frame, after computing data.res:
bobbing:update(data, walkAmount01, dt)
notes: The automatic index gives update(walkAmt, dt): the real signature is update(data, walkAmt, dt).
walkAmt is a walking intensity in [0..1] (clamped); it speeds up the step phase (4 + 6*walkAmt rad/s) and amplifies the sway. The sway is moderated by an internal factor of 0.6.
Sway angles in radians (passed to quatFromEuler(swayPitch, swayRoll, swayYaw)), vertical rise in meters (up to about 0.035 m when walking).
update adds a vec3(0,0,bobUp) to data.res.pos and multiplies data.res.rot by a sway quaternion; it must therefore be called after the camera has filled data.res.
update returns true even when it does nothing (OpenXR active, dt <= 0 or zero amplitude).

C.desc: Filter object returned by the constructor. Fields: walkBobScale, standingBobScale, t, bobPhase, phase (vec3 of random phases).

init.desc: Initializes: isFilter and hidden to true, reads the settings, resets. Called by the constructor.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Re-reads the cameraSteadycamWalkBob and cameraSteadycamStandingBob settings (clamped to 0..2, default 1). Called by camera.lua when settings change, or by the owning mode.

reset.desc: Resets time and phase to zero and draws new random phases for the sway.

update.desc: Applies the sway to data.res.pos and data.res.rot.

data.desc: Frame data: dt, res {pos, rot}, openxrSessionRunning

dt.desc: Time step in s, data.dt by default
